node.title: Re: Extracting text from MS Word files on a Linux box
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
The following works for me with [https://www.libreoffice.org/|LibreOffice] 5.1:

use IPC::System::Simple qw/capturex/; my $text = capturex('libreoffice', '--convert-to', 'txt:Text (encoded):UTF8', $filename, '--cat', '--headless'); utf8::decode($text); $text=~s/\A\x{FEFF}//; # remove BOM
